coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 2 of 8 ground-truth variables (25%): query direction and retrieval accuracy, including correct-answer rates and log-probabilities.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces the IMDb/GPT-4 dataset with Wikidata/Wikipedia cohorts and uses different models. Holds temperature at zero instead of varying it by model and context. Does not specify fixed dataset-creation, testing, and visualization scripts. Q&A and cloze templates do not explicitly establish chat-based versus completion-based model interaction modes. Uses McNemar’s test and regression rather than the specified t-tests and Kolmogorov–Smirnov tests.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion was supplied stating that child-to-parent retrieval outperforms parent-to-child retrieval, confirming the reversal curse in real-world knowledge.
